evidence.name: Screen field: Style the bullet subtitles
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the bullet subtitles" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the bullet subtitles
sections.description: Styles the secondary line under each bullet title: font, size, weight, color, alignment, and spacing, applied to all bullets at once. Keep it smaller and lighter than the bullet title so the benefit itself stays the focus. Leave the theme defaults unless the text is hard to read.
